token_definitions.payload_tokens: sum of MetadataMode.EMBED text tokens before the adapter
token_definitions.max_payload_tokens: largest per-node EMBED text token count
token_definitions.request_tokens: sum after EMBED text.replace('\n', ' ') in the adapter
token_definitions.max_request_tokens: largest per-node normalised request text token count
token_definitions.scope: local tokenizer, no special tokens; excludes provider billing and retries
